services.title: Roof Repair & Replacement
services.short: Repairs and new roofs, lifetime warranty options
services.text: We repair roofs damaged by wind, hail, trees and leaks, and install replacement roofs; as a GAF Master Elite Roofer we offer System Plus, Gold and Silver Pledge Lifetime Warranties on your new roof.

about.title: Native Houstonians with 35-plus years in roofing and insurance
text: Susan and Clint are both native Houstonians with combined 35-plus years in the roofing and insurance industry. We were created to help homeowners with the high cost of roof repairs and replacements.
Over the past 6 years we have worked several hail storms in Spring, Montgomery County, Conroe, Oakridge and the Woodlands, and sold over 800 roof replacements.
We walk you through filing an insurance claim for wind and hail damage, and as a GAF Master Elite Roofer we offer Lifetime Warranty systems on your new roof.
